english.meaning: the early part of the day
english.note: 第二朝 means the next morning. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: And don’t ask me to stay out so late or give me so much to drink—I have to get up at six the next morning.
exampleSentences.traditional: 同埋夜晚唔好再叫我出來玩咁夜，或者俾咁多酒我飲嘞。我第二朝係要六點鐘起身。

exampleSentences.english: Brew it, yeah. After brewing it all, put it in the fridge? Is that tea for the next morning?
exampleSentences.traditional: 沖，係啊。沖完晒之後入雪櫃嗎。第二朝用嗎嗰啲茶。
